24h.overallAssessment: Mostly accurate. Daytime temperatures, dry weather, thunder absence and cloud-clearing timing verified well. The main miss was the 45.1°F low at KLQK, about 5°F below the Upstate forecast range, along with unforecast 0.5-mile fog at KCEU near sunrise. Wind speeds were also slightly stronger than forecast.

highTemperature.note: Both stations verified inside the range after normal whole-degree observation rounding.

lowTemperature.note: KLEX verified inside the range; KDVK was about 1°F warmer than the upper bound.

precipitation.note: No rain was reported in the official station observations.

maximumWind.forecast: Northeast 4–8 mph with a few Lexington gusts possible
maximumWind.note: Maximum sustained wind was 10.3 mph at KDVK and 13.9 mph at KLEX; KLEX gusted to 18.4 mph.

timingLeadTime.note: Clear, dry conditions were established at the start of the verification window and persisted.

highTemperature.note: Both official stations verified inside the forecast range.

lowTemperature.note: KCEU verified inside the range, but KLQK fell to 45.1°F, about 5°F below the lower bound.

precipitation.note: No rain was reported in the official station observations.

timingLeadTime.assessment: mostly hit with a fog miss
timingLeadTime.note: KCEU became partly cloudy at 11:10 AM EDT and clear at 11:40 AM; KLQK became partly cloudy at 11:35 AM and clear at 12:15 PM, close to the late-morning clearing forecast. KCEU later reported 0.5-mile fog near 8:00 AM EDT on September 26, which was not forecast.

officialAlerts.note: The NWS historical alert API returned no actual alerts for either forecast point during the verification window.
